stickers.name: Science!
stickers.css: .vm{animation:vmk 2.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3) infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%}@keyframes vmk{0%,70%,100%{transform:scale(1)}12%{transform:scale(1.14)}24%{transform:scale(.95)}34%{transform:scale(1.03)}}.bu0{animation:bu0k 2s ease-out 0s infinite}@keyframes bu0k{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-20px);opacity:0}}.bu1{animation:bu1k 2s ease-out 0.6s infinite}@keyframes bu1k{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-20px);opacity:0}}.bu2{animation:bu2k 2s ease-out 1.2s infinite}@keyframes bu2k{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-20px);opacity:0}}

stickers.name: Recess!
stickers.css: .vm{animation:vmk 3s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes vmk{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}.bl{animation:blk 1.2s cubic-bezier(.3,0,.3,1) infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes blk{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1.04,.96)}12%{transform:translateY(0) scale(.96,1.04)}45%{transform:translateY(-14px) scale(1,1)}80%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1.06,.94)}}
